title: Nature’s Forms
subtitle: International Jewelry Exhibition 2026
quote: Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
description: Nature's Forms explores the quiet magnificence found in the organic world — the curves of eroded stone, the rhythm of waves, the intricate veins of leaves, and the raw beauty of growth and transformation.

Through the artistic lens of contemporary jewelers, these natural elements are transformed into timeless works of art in precious metal. Each piece is a dialogue between nature and craft, reflecting the harmony of imperfection and the power of enduring beauty.

featuredArtist.name: Yu-An Lin
featuredArtist.title: METALSCULPTOR
bio: Yu-An Lin draws inspiration from natural forces and organic decay, translating their raw energy into sculptural jewelry.
His works embrace imperfection, celebrating the beauty of transformation and the passage of time.
Each piece is hand-sculpted, capturing a moment of nature's ephemeral grace in enduring metal.
